Async emission-node negative tests: `emission_call_node` returns false for a non-call, a call whose target is not `req`, or a requirement method absent from the component's async operation keys. Async req calls and async arrows exercise its true branch

Canonical TypeScript type fallbacks: `ts_type` handles an empty type and erases each argument of an unknown generic; `ts_bin_op` retains parser-canonicalized `===`/`!==` aliases and unknown-op empty return. Ordinary scalar (including Bytes, Unit and Never), collection, Result, function and arithmetic types are covered

compiler-inlined definitions and emitter self-checks: the Python self-host compiler substitutes `ind`, `sync_acx` and `renders_await` at compile time, while the `expected_*` and indentation predicates are source assertions rather than paths entered by corpus emission

Crossing-label fallbacks: `call_method_name` returns `undo` for absent/empty method, fn, host or variable-callee names and unknown call shapes; `crossing_key_name` returns `?` for absent/empty requirement/name/variable identifiers or unknown targets. Lowered acquisition/undo calls carry the names used by the covered Frame bracket and compensation fixtures Issue #1972 ported the UI transaction unit into selfhost/emit_ts.rvl and added tests/fixtures/emit_py_corpus/ui_transaction_unit.rvl (joined to the ts oracle), whose unit methods walk a body through `calls_any` and so through `call_method_name`, which is why this budget fell 9 to 4.

Empty-list conservative fallbacks: `empty_list_ann` uses `any[]` when no element evidence was inferred, and `list_element` returns empty for non-List or malformed List syntax. Typed empty-list bindings and inferred persistent pushes cover the evidence-bearing paths; the frontend rejects unconstrained empty lists

Extern-body and context empty cases: `emit_externs` writes `<<EXTERN-NO-TS-BODY>>` for a declared extern without an @ts target, while `context_augmentation` returns no declaration for a document with no provided/required keys. Admitted extern fixtures carry @ts bodies; function-only documents bypass component context output at the module gate

Item 522 slice 3 (issue #1369), the UI transaction unit, ported into selfhost/emit_ts.rvl by issue #1972, together with tests/fixtures/emit_py_corpus/ui_transaction_unit.rvl (a shared corpus document, joined to the ts oracle). This tier runs 79 corpus documents against the python tier's 105, so more of the new code stays unexecuted here, and part of it is a future document rather than a structural floor: `ui_crossing_wrapper`'s `export async function ... uiCrossingAsync` arm and `runtime_imports`'s `names.append('uiCrossingAsync')` need a computer-use extern that is ASYNC, and the corpus's only `compensate`-declaring computer-use extern (`type_amount`) is sync. `reaches_computer_use`'s four unexecuted statements are its `{kind: 'call', callee: {kind: 'var'}}` arm - whose only corpus node lives inside the module `fn peek_pane` and is read at emit time - and the `compensate`/`undo` inverse-key skip beside it. `ui_verb_known` is one `return (... or ...)` statement and `is_computer_use_token`'s `len(segs) < 2` arm needs an undotted capability token; every capability in the corpus and in revl.ui_family.REVERSIBILITY is dotted. The input family is tests/test_selfhost_emit_ts.py and backends/typescript/tests/ui_transaction.test.ts.

Legacy expression-type inference: `is_float_expr` handles unstamped literal Float and returns false for non-minus unary expressions; `surface_type` retains widen-Int, legacy name-id, Float/Str/Int/Bool literals, and unknown literal/list element (the `index` arm, the #957 `Map` value type included, is covered). Current typed IR carries operand/expected stamps on the covered forms

Legacy v1 format escape: `render_format` consumes `$$` as one literal dollar before scanning `$N` argument placeholders. Current `compile_files` lowers backtick interpolation to v3 `kind=interp` with explicit text/expr parts (including literal dollar text), never to `kind=format`; v1 component routing is retained only in the Python reference emitter

Lexical scan rejection edges: `is_digit` rejects non-ASCII digits; `is_word_ch` rejects non-ASCII letters/punctuation and accepts digits/underscore only after its covered ASCII-letter branch; `is_word` rejects an empty string or one containing such a character. Frontend identifier tokens are nonempty ASCII words; covered interpolation and binding fixtures exercise their admitted path

Literal and match optional guards: `literal_of` maps a null host value, which source literals do not expose; `match_expr`'s no-binding Some arm checks payload against `undefined`, while lowered source Some patterns bind their payload. None/Some and Result/variant match output is otherwise covered

Nested component-guard frame tests: the remaining `body_has_bracket` and `body_needs_frame` statements are the true returns from recursively scanning an `if` arm. Source component guards admit only `fail` and nested guards (G6), so an arm cannot contain the effect/compensation needed to make either recursive call true; top-level effects and provide-method compensation exercise the reachable true paths

Owned-write negative shapes: `is_inplace_write` returns false when an assignment's value is neither record-update nor builtin, when uniqueness is absent, and when the builtin is not push/set/remove with the required arity. Covered unique collection updates take the optimization; all other assignments remain on the normal renderer

Parenthesization and empty-update forms: `render_call` wraps a non-atomic call target and `render_record_update` emits a spread-only object when updates are empty. The frontend emits direct var/field call targets and requires at least one source record update field

Timer-emission colouring fallbacks: `emission_is_async` returns false for a call whose target is not a requirement, and tests a variable callee against the document's async callables. A timer body admits only emissions, and every admitted one lowers to a requirement-target `call` or to a component-dialect `fn` node, so neither arm has an input; the reference's `_ts_emission_is_async` carries the same three unreached statements. An async extern reached from a timer is refused by the reference before this test runs ("called outside an async context")

Type-string parser sentinels: `fn_type_arrow_index` returns -2 for a leading parenthesis not followed by `->` or with no closing parenthesis; `last_index` reaches -1 when a generic close bracket is missing. Canonical type strings originate in the frontend and exercise balanced function/generic forms

Unsupported-node sentinels: `component_step`, `method_body`, `expr_inner`, `render_builtin`, `render_un`, `v3_stmt`, `lifecycle_step` and `render_do` produce explicit `<<UNSUPPORTED-*>>` output only after every mirrored step/expression/operator/method arm misses. Positive corpus input is frontend-lowered to the covered arms, and the reference raises on each of these shapes; the witnessed family is refused before this renderer
v1 component type fallback is outside the mirrored v3 contract; routing selects the legacy reference emitter before self-host emission
